title: The owner's in-room commands
what: The setting commands the owner types in a room, read off the policy's phrases into a mode, a delegation, a mute, the notices and the pictures switch.

title: The receiver's judgement of a message
what: What becomes of a message a chat service hands over: the room allowed, the owner's commands, the archive row kept with its metadata, the wake handed on, and the lines the receiver says itself.

title: The files a message carried
what: Every voice note, audio file, video and document kept from a chat service under the room's folder, its collected-items row and the rule that keeping the same file twice changes nothing.

title: The notice a setting change leaves
what: The fact queued for a room's session after the owner changes one of its settings, so the session acknowledges it in the room's own voice.

title: The pictures a room keeps
what: A picture a message carried, downscaled and laid on white before it is stored under the room's picture folder, and a word drawn into a picture's own band.

title: The pinned order and a job's board
what: The rooms the console stands over the rest in the owner's order, and the board of running jobs a job left pinned in the owner's chat.

title: The receiver's room reads
what: What the receiver answers of a room: its messages and pages, unread counts and read marks, pictures walked, senders, and the figures counted off its own record.

title: The wake
what: Which designated agents of a room a message wakes by one rule, what stands before it in the rest's gate, the read mark, a mute and a room rule, and the owner's answer to a job's question.
